label: No first member: causal incoming versus separate strict order
term: no first member of an entire causal chain
resolution: Two approved analyst senses of 'no first member' for the shared A2/A10 entire-chain vocabulary, attribution deferred. NO_FIRST_MEMBER_1 (CausalNoFirst): no selected member lacks an incoming full or partial cause from selected members; self-loops count. NO_FIRST_MEMBER_2 (OrderedNoFirst): no selected member is minimal under a separately supplied irreflexive transitive order on the same carrier; incomparable members are allowed and absence of a least member is not enough. Which sense each use takes: an A2 use about a productive causal head (Chain.Head) takes sense 1, since causal_noFirst_excludes_head consumes CausalNoFirst; an A2 or A10 use that reads 'first' as earliest in a separately given precedence takes sense 2, and its externality step (ordered_minimum_uncaused) additionally needs productivity, both-relation closure and the incoming-cause-to-order guard. No step passes between the senses without the explicit selected-endpoint Aligned premise (aligned_noFirst_iff); alignment_omission shows a self-causing loop satisfying sense 1 but not sense 2 when alignment is omitted, and intOrder shows sense 2 is nonvacuous on an infinite strict order with no production edges. The A10 cause is a prior partial explanatory condition (disambiguation b5d2699d), not the productive Chain cause/partialCause primitive of TruthCore.Causality.EntireChainHead. Applying either sense to an A10 use therefore needs an explicit, still OPEN bridge from A10 explanatory conditions to Chain production; it is not supplied by the shared vocabulary. No registered argument consumes either sense yet. Neither sense maps or replaces the original composite sense _3 of the A2 (18495e19) or A10 (b5d2699d) disambiguation, whose first-member clause, applicability and coverage remain OPEN.
